title: EU household electricity prices and energy-efficient appliances (EarlyDex open data)
description: Open data compiled by EarlyDex (https://earlydex.com/): average household electricity prices in the 27 EU countries (Eurostat nrg_pc_204, all taxes included), the most energy-efficient fridge-freezers, refrigerators, washing machines, heat-pump tumble dryers and dishwashers ranked from the EU energy label database EPREL (European Commission), and the tables of the EarlyDex report 2026: share of energy classes among all registered washing machines, dishwashers and tumble dryers, and their yearly electricity cost in each EU country. Updated monthly.
